Mr Bharath - Tamil movie
Star Cast: Rajinikanth, Sathyaraj, Raghuvaran, Goundamani, Ambika, Visu, Sharada
Music: Ilayaraja
Direction: S P Muthuraman
Description : Mr Bharath is a Tamil drama film. Rajinikanth learns that his mother was cheated and left in the lurch by Sathyaraj, who has since then gone on to earn great wealth in the construction business in Madras. Swearing to make his father publicly
admit that he was his son, Rajinikanth travels to Madras and enters the construction business.
